answer: Tie each agent's standing to a costly, non-transferable stake verified by a cipher-signed hardware attestation. The rewards every agent chases, the nectar of the market, accrue only to identities backed by proven unique stake, so cloning yourself splits one pool thinner instead of multiplying it. An attacker minting a thousand ivory-smooth facades still posts a thousand real bonds; the economics, not a gatekeeper, make sybils unprofitable.
